about.meta_description: Lotten is a direct-to-consumer Malaysian Oak furniture maker. We control every step from timber to finish — honest furniture at honest prices.
about.title: About Lotten
about.p1: Lotten is a direct-to-consumer furniture maker specialising in Malaysian Oak — a hardwood prized for its tight grain, warm tone, and dimensional stability. Our pieces are designed for real homes: simple silhouettes, honest joinery, and finishes that age gracefully.
about.p2: We control the entire journey from timber selection to final finish in our Malaysian workshop. There are no middlemen, no showroom markups, and no inflated list prices. Every product is priced to reflect what it actually costs to make — plus a fair margin.
about.p3: The result is heirloom-quality furniture at manufacturer-direct prices, delivered to homes across Malaysia. We believe in craftsmanship that respects the material, the maker, and the customer in equal measure.
about.item_1_text: for living rooms, media walls, and dining spaces.
about.item_2_text: in solid Malaysian Oak with hand-applied finishes.
about.item_3_text: designed for home offices and small spaces.
about.item_4_text: across three brands — NestHouZ, NestNordic, and Luooma — each with its own design language.

faq.meta_description: Answers to common questions about LottenFurniture — sizing, finishes, delivery timelines, and returns.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.still_question_suffix: — we typically reply within one business day.
faq.q1: Are your products made from solid Malaysian Oak?
faq.a1: Most pieces are built from solid Malaysian Oak for structural parts (legs, frames, tops) and use MDF with ash veneer for panel bodies — the same industry-standard construction you'll find in premium furniture. Each product's specifications list the materials and finishes in detail.
faq.a2: Stocked items typically ship within 3–5 business days. Made-to-order items have a lead time of 6–10 weeks depending on the collection. The lead time for each product is shown on its detail page and on our shipping info page.
faq.a3: Currently we deliver within Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysia. For international enquiries, please email sales@lottenfurniture.com and we'll quote separately.
faq.a4: Finishes vary by collection — Natural, Cocoa, Walnut, White Marble, White Wash, Black, and a small number of accent codes (Gold, Space Blue). Each product page lists the finish codes with the materials used.
faq.q5: Can I see a piece before buying?
faq.a5: Yes. Our workshop is in Selangor and visits are by appointment. Email sales@lottenfurniture.com to arrange a viewing — we'll have the pieces you're considering ready.
faq.a6: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery on undamaged, unused items in their original packaging. Custom and made-to-order pieces are non-returnable unless defective. See our returns page for full details.

shipping.meta_description: Delivery timelines and shipping options for Lotten furniture within Malaysia.
shipping.title: Shipping Information
shipping.subtitle: We deliver throughout Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysia. All shipping is handled in-house — no third-party logistics — so your piece arrives exactly as it left the workshop.
shipping.stocked_text: 3–5 business days within Peninsular Malaysia; 5–10 business days to East Malaysia.
shipping.mto_text: 6–10 weeks depending on the collection and finish. The lead time for each product is shown on its detail page.
shipping.custom_text: Quoted individually at the time of order.
shipping.rates_intro: Flat-rate shipping is calculated at checkout based on state and order size:
shipping.rate_east: Sabah and Sarawak: RM 250 per shipment.
shipping.rate_free: Orders above RM 2,000 ship free within Peninsular Malaysia.
shipping.rates_note: Rates are reviewed quarterly. Confirm at checkout before placing your order.
shipping.track_prefix: Once your order ships we'll send a tracking link by email. Having trouble?

returns.meta_description: Lotten's 30-day return policy for undamaged items, and the conditions for made-to-order pieces.
returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
returns.subtitle: We want you to live with your furniture — not just look at it. If a piece doesn't work in your space, you have 30 days from delivery to return it.
returns.eligibility_1: Items must be unused, undamaged, and in their original packaging.
returns.eligibility_2: Made-to-order and custom-built pieces are non-returnable unless defective.
returns.eligibility_3: Final-sale or clearance items are non-returnable; this is stated on the product page before purchase.
returns.start_suffix: with your order number and a short description of the issue. We'll reply with return instructions and arrange pickup if needed.
returns.refunds_text: Once we receive and inspect the returned item, we'll refund the purchase price to your original payment method within 5–10 business days. Original shipping is non-refundable except in the case of a defective or wrong-item shipment.
